_doc: Per-mod settings an installer could change so a mod's conflicting part stands aside (docs/328 §7.4). For Apex's setup installer (Apex owns it): the installer shows the player each change and lets them decline it, and changes settings only, never mod files. settings = verified player-controlled options (NRaas setting, ini or tuning option the mod exposes) with mod, build, setting, value, reason, evidence; when = the ts3native / ts3fixes switch state the change applies under (absent = always); kind = recommended (offer it) or optional (offer it only on the stated sign). keep = settings checked and left at their default, with the reason (the installer changes nothing, it may show them). notices = no setting exists; the installer can only tell the player. candidatesChecked = rows where a setting was looked for and none fits. No mod code or data is copied here: names, ids, builds and verdicts only.
